name: Wallaya Residence Nai Harn
shortDescription: Off-plan low-rise condominium of 285 studio to 3-bedroom apartments in seven-storey buildings near Nai Harn Beach, by Wallaya Villas.
description:
Wallaya Residence Nai Harn is the first condominium by Wallaya Villas, a developer better known for pool-villa estates such as The Harmony by Wallaya Villas in Thalang. It is planned as a group of seven-storey buildings with 285 apartments, about 2 km from Nai Harn Beach and close to Rawai.
Units are compact and priced evenly, at about THB 125,000 per sqm: studios of 36 sqm, one-bedrooms of 54 sqm, two-bedrooms of 90 sqm and three-bedrooms of 94 sqm. The shared facilities are generous for the size of the units: a pool and children's pool, gym, spa, co-working room, kids' club, restaurant and rooftop areas.
The project is off plan with completion of the first phase planned for December 2027. Advertised units are mostly leasehold, with freehold available at a premium within the foreign quota.
